name: handtap-access
description: Control your computer with hand and face gestures, using AI that runs on your device and adapts to your body
author: HandTap

scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:worker && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron ."
scripts.test: node --test src/tracking.test.js src/keybinds.test.js src/real-hands.test.js src/gesture-model.test.js src/overlay.test.js src/adaptive-input.test.js
scripts.dist: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
